comment: The expected OpenFlights mosaic: what a clean build of pattern.yaml gives from the tesserae its sources make (docs/spec-0.1.md section 11). Each source names a pinned download of manifest.json, its settings file here and the piece it becomes. knowledge_hash is section 3.6; counts, weak_ids and notices are the build report's (section 7.2); conflicts and alias_conflicts are how many the report lists. Recorded from two clean local builds; these values are the contract, so a change to them needs a reason.
